title: Schematic Render Interal Line Visibility
content:
Before the update, it was possible to show or hide individual internal lines in the property editor. After the update, the property editor box no longer makes a difference for individual lines in schematic render mode. The only way to hide internal lines now is by deactivating the general visibility of all internal lines in the schematic render window. Is there anything that could be done about this?

![5288849393b84d9d998c10db49f52495](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202504/8f1679e56f2443cbab56c6d6feadaf01/images/5288849393b84d9d998c10db49f5249568498498498498498.jpg)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi. Thank you for alerting us. we have reported this to our Dev Team

title: Last Update
content:
After the last update I have a few issues:

1) Cannot see all available buttons in the property editor when click on the button image. Black screen comes up - see attached a screenshot.

2) Cannot see standard avatar sizes in the dropdown menu like it was before. Available only default - see attached a screenshot.

3) When rendering, texture files (vignettes) aren't there. It takes me to program files and I need to find the right file and then find the vignette I need - see attached the third screenshot.

These are just three issues, but there were a few other ones, e.g. constant crashes. Wish I never updated because it's **_really annoying._**

Please advise how I can fix the above mentioned problems.

Thanks,

Anna

![fa74678f9c6f4456af97b6cbce449196](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202504/42700f539d8446d59aa1d510f2b56210/images/fa74678f9c6f4456af97b6cbce449196Screenshot%202025-04-18%20005000.png)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Ariel,I figured out how to go about issue 3, so the panic is over 🙂. Upload avatar => choose some size => avatar editor and then the dropdown menu gives sizes - see screenshot attached. So, Ariel, no need to bother developers about this issue. But now I have the library issue: after reinstalment, when I use new library, all CLO default assets - Garment, Avatar, Fabric, Trim, Stage - are there. But when I revert to the previous library look which I much prefer, it's empty. There are no CLO default assets - see attached the screenshot. So, I will be grateful if you could find out how to bring into the old style library all default CLO assets.

Comment 2: Hi Anna.So sorry about this. For 1, 2 and 3 It looks like the issue here is that when you updated the Registry did not properly update. (basically the path files are not synced up) The fastest way to correct this is to Completely uninstall CLO from your computer and then reinstall.You can find information about uninstalling fully here - https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/42700f539d8446d59aa1d510f2b56210#:~:text=Go%20to%20Windows%20Start%20%3E%20Settings,software%20using%20the%20above%20method.Once fully uninstalled you can then reinstall directly from our website here - https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/42700f539d8446d59aa1d510f2b56210

Issues 1 and 3 have been sorted , but issue 2 is not: I still cannot see standard avatar sizes in the dropdown menu like it was before. Available only default - see attached a screenshot.Also, library. When I use new library, all CLO default assets - Garment, Avatar, Fabric, Trim, Stage - are there. But when I revert to the previous library look which I much prefer, it's empty. There are no CLO default assets - see attached the screenshot.
Reply 2: Hi! So glad 1 and 3 are solved.As for 2 I will have to ask our Dev team as I have not seen this issue

Reply 2: Hi Mark, please excuse the late reply. Starting from version 2025.0, the way the display settings (toggled in the 3D/2D views) are handled has been changed; instead of saving them to the registry, they are now managed through the display settings system.Therefore, when Ctrl+N is used, it loads the Default_Modelist.zprj file and applies the settings saved in that file. As a result, this behavior is expected and not considered a bug.As a workaround, under main menu --> Settings --> User Settings --> Default Files, you can replace the new default project with a blank file that doesn't have the ground grid turned on.
content_description: This page seeks to troubleshoot and resolve the persistent reappearance of the 3D ground grid in the 3D window when creating new garments.

title: Trouble dropping in designs into patterns after new update.
content:
Is anyone else experiencing significant issues when applying specific designs to their corresponding pattern templates? Every time I get close to aligning the design correctly, it suddenly shifts to a different area. This problem only began after the most recent updates. Any guidance or support would be greatly appreciated.
